title: PR #60: fix(ci): repair current red L1/Rust gates
content:
State: open
Merged: False
Draft: False

Fixes source-level failures observed on the latest failing main gate.

Evidence baseline:
- Ecosystem Release Readiness run 36254952534 failed in rust-manifests.
- Ecosystem Integration run 36254952541 failed in workspace check.
- L1 Network E2E run 36254952555 failed in all four Rust E2E jobs.
- Determinism Gate run 36254952586 failed for a-townchain Rust static scan.
- Blockchain Core Integration run 36254952589 failed formatting in atc-node, atc-sdk and atc-blockchain, plus check in atc-indexer.

Changes in this PR:
- align kernel Transaction constructors with the already-implemented u128 monetary amount field;
- decode RPC transaction amount as u128, including full-width decimal string input;
- apply verified rustfmt corrections in the failing Rust files.

No CI gate is weakened and no historical/archive content is changed.

L1-TX-001 remains the governing contract gate; this PR only repairs concrete red build/type/format failures without migrating wallet signing semantics.
